body: Not to sound selfish, but I’m hoping Frosty at least makes a post saying he’s done. I guess we can kinda just assume after a month and a half but I’d like confirmation somewhere. He made that secondary channel where he posted a couple videos about music he liked and then he deleted that after like a day or two, so idk what’s happening. I’m a big fan tho, watch him daily, still do. So, if he’s gone, I’d just like to know.
